description: This file defines a DashboardFragment class for an Android application UI, managing user interactions for arithmetic operations and binding UI components to a ViewModel.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides a calculator-like interface, handling user input, display of results, and interaction with a ViewModel.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up observers for ViewModel LiveData, and binds button click listeners to perform operations or clear inputs.

methods.name: currentA
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the first operand input as a String.

methods.name: currentB
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the second operand input as a String.
